dialogues.speaker: Joyce
dialogues.text: Please exercise extreme caution. Do not touch the meteorites with your bare hands.

dialogues.speaker: Adler
dialogues.text: Please keep a safe distance from the meteorites. Only approach the impact site if you have business concerning the meteorites.

dialogues.speaker: Hartman
dialogues.text: Thank you all! I must get back to the Winery and let everyone know that I'm safe.

dialogues.speaker: Recuperated Victim
dialogues.text: Huh...? W—Was I asleep? ...Gosh, how long was I out?

dialogues.speaker: Edna
dialogues.text: May the Anemo Archon spare you from the effects of the meteorites.

dialogues.speaker: Yunjiang
dialogues.text: Leave the patrolling of the area to me! ...But as far as dealing with the meteorites goes, I've heard you're the ones who know what you're doing?

dialogues.speaker: Tiancheng
dialogues.text: I haven't had a moment's rest since the meteorite strikes started... Now I think about it, the sleepers don't have it so bad, do they?

dialogues.speaker: Lao Cai
dialogues.text: While the Millelith stands guard, evil shall never prevail. Please report any new incidents to me.

dialogues.speaker: Recuperated Victim
dialogues.text: *yawn* ...Hmm? What're you staring at me for?

dialogues.speaker: Recuperated Victim
dialogues.text: Now I'm awake, can I go back home? I just want to go home...

dialogues.speaker: Recuperated Victim
dialogues.text: I hear you've been clearing away the meteorites? Nice work! There's a lot to be said for being young and fit, I suppose!

dialogues.speaker: Jinglun
dialogues.text: Meteorites, can you believe it... First time for everything, I guess!

dialogues.speaker: Huaqing
dialogues.text: Hey, who's that! ...Oh, you're the adventurers here to help out. Sorry. Your help is greatly appreciated.

dialogues.speaker: Bro Huang
dialogues.text: This has been a long shift... I'm getting hungry.

dialogues.speaker: Yang
dialogues.text: Something about watching these people sleeping is making me sleepy, too... Ahem! No, I would never sleep on the job!

dialogues.speaker: Gao the Sixth
dialogues.text: A bowl of piping hot food right after I woke up... Just what I needed!

dialogues.speaker: Check Victim
dialogues.text: The victim is still deep in sleep.
